summary: Curaleaf filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, publishing an investor brochure urging Aurora Cannabis shareholders to tender into its offer to acquire Aurora and combine the businesses. The solicitation cites a 45% premium, a combined platform spanning 17 countries, over US$1.5B LTM revenue, nearly US$350M adjusted EBITDA, and at least US$40M of annual cost synergies. The filing is a Rule 425 written communication; no board recommendation, advisor, consideration mix, or outside date is stated. Watch tender uptake versus Aurora's standalone turnaround guidance as the key arbitrage variable.
